PreliminaryStatement (l)Owner and Developer entered into that certain Zoning Lot and Development Agreement dated January 4, 2019 recorded on January 30, 2109 with the City Register of the City of New York, Kings County as CRFN 2019000034616 (the “Original ZLDA") transferring 4,180 square feet of Development rights from Owner's Parcel to Developer's Parcel (as those terms are defined below); and (Il) After the recording of the Original ZLDA, three (3) additional Zoning Lot and Development Agreements, each dated January 4, 2019 and affecting Developer's Parcel and Owner's Parcel, were erroneously recorded with the City Register of the City of New York, Kings County (the "Office") as follows: (1) on February 14, 2019 as CRFN 2019000052770; (2) on March 15, 2019 as CRFN 2019000086126 and (3) on March 18,2019 as CRFN 2019000086919 (collectively,the "Erroneous ZLDAs") and erroneous Certifications were recorded with the Office as CRFN 2019000034617 and CRFN 2019000052771 (the “Erroneous Certifications"); and (lll) Theparties desiretoterminate the Original ZLDA,theErroneousZLDAs and theErroneous Agreement.
